description:
We’re CSE students interested in web development, AI/ML, data analysis, UI/UX, and building practical solutions. We enjoy turning ideas into simple, interactive applications and are excited to solve NASA-related challenges. We’re looking for teammates interested in AI/ML, data science, design, development, visualization, astronomy, or research. No expert experience required—curiosity, creativity, and teamwork matter most.
